evidence.moatW: セグメント別売上(FY2025 10-K Note 15, 総額2,791,687千$): Industrial Precision Solutions 1,331,792=47.7% / Medical and Fluid Solutions 835,385=29.9% / Advanced Technology Solutions 624,510=22.4%(出典: 10-K 2025-10-31 Operating Segments and Geographic Area Data R95・R24)。原本の各セグメント記述で終端市場が別系統: IPS『primarily serves the industrial, agricultural, consumer durables and non-durables markets』(接着剤・塗料の精密塗布)、MFS『plastic tubing, balloons, catheters, syringes, cartridges, tips and fluid connection components are used to dispense or control fluids within customers' medical devices』(医療機器向け流体部品=医療規制/設計組込)、ATS『Applications include ... semiconductors, printed circuit boards, electronic components and automotive electronics, in-line measurement sensors, gauges and analyzers』(電子実装の表面処理・塗布・検査)。顧客集中は『No single customer accounted for 10 percent or more of sales in 2025, 2024 or 2023』。3事業は顧客基盤・認定障壁・競合が各々独立し、1本折れても残り2本が立つ。→ 独立した堀は3本(各≥売上15%)と判定=100
